baseline: Frozen signed G01 962637; source-only G04 opt-in. No engine build or GPU test by reviewer.
generatedSourceCheck: review/GENERATED-SOURCE-CHECK.json; tiny clang++ C++ source-output tool -Wall -Wextra -Werror, four high/shadow variants. G04 OFF byte-identical to G01 and ON anchors all construct.
findings: ON g04Dots0 maps exactly BL/TL/TR and g04Dots1 maps TR/BR/BL from the current vertex Run outputs; the new fields are [[flat]] and copy through the same DecalVarying first-provoking vertex as existing flat corner data. Original G01 cyclic vid rotation is unchanged.

The new dot helper preserves v0=p2-p0, v1=p1-p0, and dot00/dot01/dot11 operand order. Fragment still computes depth-dependent v2, dot02/dot12, original denominator reciprocal, s/t/q, both triangle checks, and UV/fract.

g04WrapRatio initializes to 1.0; successful Run performs the same >0 guard and midpoint/distance/divide expression. Three new outputs initialize before original early-cull return; no new read of existing uninitialized fields.

OFF overload returns the original two-argument generator directly. ON source transforms only unique known anchors; failure throws before library creation. Original atlas shader suffix and argument count are unchanged in generated outputs.

hoistG04 and probeG04 are owner-const env values, so owner-private library/pipeline cache keys cannot mix ON/OFF within one owner. No new uniform, GPU allocation, registration, draw hook, or math-mode change.

PROBE=1 log occurs after successful library creation/cache insertion but before pipeline creation/draw. It proves library compilation, not actual draw or output parity. PROBE=0 bypasses logging and formatting.
remainingRequiredProof: Actual MSL compilation for all used high/shadow variants and pipeline interface/linking is outside this CPU source check.

Source equivalence does not prove cross-stage floating-point bit identity near zero/nonfinite denominators, signed zero, NaN/Inf, wrap boundaries or exact barycentric acceptance edges; GPU color/depth/stencil parity remains required.
New seven flat scalar components plus vertex arithmetic can outweigh fragment savings; no performance claim before measured same-engine work.
disposition: No source contract blocker to the bounded helper/production syntax stage; do not treat CPU check as GPU parity.
